skill.summary: Trade crypto on OKX with a strict human-in-the-loop confirmation gate. Use when the user asks to check OKX balances, look up prices, propose or execute trade...

latestVersion.changelog: v0.3.1 — okx_snapshot.py now reports 1D/1W/1Y price changes per watched instrument. Pulls daily candles from OKX /market/candles + /market/history-candles (paginated for year-back). Output gains a 'Price moves:' section; snapshot JSON gains a price_changes block. Pass --no-price-history to skip the historical lookup for faster ad-hoc summaries.
